response.sql: WITH signal_telescope_join AS (SELECT s.signalregistry, s.pulsepersec, t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry), telescope_avg_pulse AS (SELECT telescregistry, equipstatus, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_per_telescope FROM signal_telescope_join WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescregistry, equipstatus), status_avg_pulse AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_per_telescope) as avg_pulse_per_status FROM telescope_avg_pulse GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_per_status) as first_mean_value FROM status_avg_pulse), kept_after_first_filter AS (SELECT s.equipstatus, s.avg_pulse_per_status, (s.avg_pulse_per_status - f.first_mean_value) as excess_over_first FROM status_avg_pulse s CROSS JOIN first_mean f WHERE s.avg_pulse_per_status > f.first_mean_value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_per_status) as second_mean_value FROM kept_after_first_filter), kept_after_second_filter AS (SELECT equipstatus, avg_pulse_per_status, excess_over_first, (avg_pulse_per_status - s.second_mean_value) as excess_over_second FROM kept_after_first_filter CROSS JOIN second_mean s WHERE avg_pulse_per_status > s.second_mean_value) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_per_status) as final_avg, AVG(excess_over_first) as avg_excess_over_first, AVG(excess_over_second) as avg_excess_over_second FROM kept_after_second_filter
